subject: Culture
title: Jazz Funerals
description: A quick, practical guide to Jazz Funerals.

hook.text: In New Orleans, a brass band plays mournful hymns to the grave—then breaks into jubilant jazz on the walk home.

buildup.text: Jazz funerals blend West African celebration of ancestors with Catholic burial traditions and brass band culture.

discovery.text: The shift from dirge to dance represents transformation: grief gives way to celebration of the life lived.

twist.text: The tradition nearly died in the 1970s. Young musicians revived it, making it a symbol of New Orleans resilience.

climax.text: After Hurricane Katrina, jazz funerals became acts of defiance—proof that the culture survived the flood.

punchline.text: The best funerals make you dance your way back to life.

quiz.question: What cultural traditions merged to create jazz funerals?
